Was a termination notice received?
Is the flat the family home (ordinary termination of a family home)?

notes.text: Then verify the notice, receipt, form, service, end date, and stated termination type.
Apply arrears, family-home, retaliation, and hardship evidence only when that branch is active.
Separate formal validity, factual grounds, extension, and settlement questions.
Request only missing evidence that changes one of those decisions.
